feeds.title: Irish Jesuits Blog
feeds.description: Irish Jesuits are engaged in a wide range of work both at home and throughout the world. They are also joined in their work by laymen and women, both friends and colleagues. They are united by their faith in a God who wants all men and women to be truly free and live as Children of God. They are committed Catholics who want to know, love, and follow Jesus. Go through their blog and learn more about news, books, podcasts, informational videos, features, and more.

feeds.title: Quakers in Ireland
feeds.description: Quakers have a great diversity of beliefs, and while words can divide them, the shared experience of silent worship, seeking to practice Christ's message of love and compassion unites them. They know theirs is not the only path to God, but believe it is the right one for them. They are formally known as the Religious Society of Friends. Dive into their blog and learn more about the latest news, resources, events, and more.

feeds.title: Irish Society for Christian Civilisation Blog
feeds.description: Irish Society for Christian Civilization is an organization of lay Catholic Irishmen and Irishwomen concerned with the moral crisis shaking the remnants of Christendom. Today, with its members, volunteers, and donors, they are on the front lines of the culture war, peacefully defending the values of tradition, family, and property. Explore more through their blog and learn more about their informational videos, articles, activities, and much more.

feeds.title: The Irish Catholic
feeds.description: The Irish Catholic is Ireland's biggest and best-selling religious newspaper. The newspaper, published weekly, provides a lively mix of news, analysis, and informed commentary about the Church and social issues as they affect Ireland and the wider world. Check out their blog and learn more about the latest news, reviews, services, products, and more.

feeds.title: Association Of Catholic Priests Blog
feeds.description: Catholic Priests who wish to have a forum, and a voice to reflect, discuss, and comment on issues affecting the Irish Church and society today. Visit their blog to learn about the Liturgy, other useful resources, events, articles, services, and more.

feeds.title: Irish Papist
feeds.description: Irish Papist shares poems, articles, and more on their blog. Wade through their blog and learn more about poets, poems, articles, past stories, experiences, and more.

feeds.title: The Irish Peace Process Blog
feeds.description: From the beginning, the Irish peace process has appeared to have more political than moral content, with more immediate attention to the demands of paramilitaries than to the rights of victims. That those who committed mass murder and a vast number of human rights violations should don the costumes of civil rights heroes and seek honors resulting from merely ending their unwarranted violence is perturbing and worthy of analytical commentary. Explore more through their blog.

feeds.title: Church News Ireland
feeds.description: Church News Ireland

feeds.title: Christian Unions Ireland
feeds.description: Christian Unions Ireland exists to give every student in Ireland an opportunity to respond to the gospel of Jesus Christ. Visit their blog and learn more about their services, the latest news, informational articles, and much more.

feeds.title: Christ Church Cathedral
feeds.description: Christ Church Cathedral is the diocesan cathedral of the Church of Ireland Dioceses of Dublin and Glendalough. Their pattern of worship and prayer is formed by The Book of Common Prayer. They value both ecumenical and interfaith engagement and look for opportunities to make the cathedral space a place of welcome and dialogue. Go through their blog and learn more about their services, the latest news, events, tours, videos, and more.

feeds.title: Saint Patrick's Cathedral
feeds.description: Saint Patrick's Cathedral has been at the center of Dublin and Ireland's history and culture for more than 800 years. It is the country's biggest cathedral and one of the most significant pilgrimage destinations. In a small way, their narrative mirrors Ireland's history. Have a look at their blog to find out more about its history and the interesting people who contributed to the creation of their tale, the latest news, events, articles, and more.

feeds.title: Christ City Church Dublin Blog
feeds.description: Christ City Church is a Christian community in Dublin that is committed to making a difference in the city spiritually, socially, and culturally. They officially launched on 12th October 2014 and currently meeting in two locations, CCC South in Stillorgan and CCC Central in Portobello, on Sundays. Check out their blog and learn more about articles, internships, services, resources, events, and more.

feeds.title: Irish Church Missions
feeds.description: Irish Church Missions exists to raise up leaders and release a movement of church planting so that every community in Ireland is reached with the life-giving power of the gospel of Jesus Christ again. They know that they need creativity, innovation, and courage if they want to break new ground with the gospel. They're committed to seeing the work through, and won't stop until they see their mission realized. Get into their blog and learn more about their services, stories, projects, articles, and more.

feeds.title: House of Brigid Blog
feeds.description: The House of Brigid invites recent college graduates to live as an intentional lay community for one year, dedicating themselves to the service of the Irish Catholic Church and to spiritual and personal formation. It is committed to allowing its members a year of personal and spiritual growth. Check out their blog and learn more about their services, career, community, and more.

feeds.title: Church In Chains
feeds.description: Church in Chains is an independent Irish charity that encourages prayer and action in support of persecuted Christians worldwide, with a special focus on some countries. It coordinates a network of prayer groups that meet monthly or quarterly. It runs a letter-writing team with members who write to ambassadors, presidents, and government officials to advocate on behalf of persecuted Christians. Get into their blog and know more about their services, latest news, reports, policies, videos, podcasts, and more.

feeds.title: Christian Meditation Ireland Blog
feeds.description: Christian Meditation Ireland is a community of men and women who are committed to the practice of meditation in Ireland in the Christian tradition. Their core aim is to animate and support the practice of Christian meditation in Ireland by communicating and nurturing the teaching and practice of the tradition. They strive to do this by providing a range of support and events, in-person and online. Check out their blog and learn more about news, resources, events, and more.

feeds.title: CatholicVoice
feeds.description: Catholic Voice is Ireland's latest and fastest-growing Catholic newspaper. Their mission is simple, they exist only to serve the Church in complete fidelity to the Holy. See-through their writing and publishing. They are committed to presenting the Catholic message in an authentic and clear way. Browse more through their blog.

feeds.title: Evangelical Alliance Ireland
feeds.description: Evangelical Alliance Ireland's focus was on encouraging Christians and churches to engage with one another and their communities at both local and national levels. They endeavor to present an evangelical Christian perspective in the public sphere on issues of national importance. They aim to do this in partnership with Christians and churches throughout Ireland by encouraging and equipping them to the extent that our own resources allow. Visit their blog and know more about the latest news, services, events, and more.

feeds.title: Sligo Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: At Sligo Baptist, they believe that everybody should have a personal and living faith in Jesus as described in the Bible. They believe everyone can experience a new spiritual life through Jesus and that those who do will be changed by his Holy Spirit. It is keen to initiate new ministries and churches wherever the Good News of Jesus needs to be declared in fresh ways. Browse more through their blog about services, articles, new series, and more.

feeds.title: Compassion Ireland Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1952, Compassion is a Christian child development charity releasing children from poverty, in Jesus' name. They partner with local churches within communities experiencing poverty. Their heart is to give children and young people the opportunity to thrive and reach their God-given potential both now and into the future. Go through their blog and learn more about their services, news, magazines, resources, programs, events, articles, and more.

feeds.title: Church of Ireland
feeds.description: The Church of Ireland believes in the equality, within the body of Christ, of all the baptized. They continuously serve its membership and wider society across the island's two political jurisdictions. Dive into their blog and learn more about their resources, latest news, and much more.
